title: Better when it's heard, not seen

contact_edits.before: When the lady, who's like a walking, talking copy of Cosmopolitan, offers as a last resort to go down on Steve and is refused, her fury at the man she's conditioned to despise knows no bounds. For once, the humble and meek get exalted; and if the mighty aren't exactly put down from their seats, they are at least obliged to shuffle a little. The actors may be physically hard to discern, but aurally they're very present. This theatre production is terrific radio. - In Toronto until Saturday. Call 416-973-4000; at the PuSh Festival in Vancouver from Jan 30-Feb 3.
